NOTE
**Still not ready — merge commit is still in the history**

New: The author pushed twice and asked @Asteriskkkk to review. Missing: the commit list still includes "Merge branch 'main' into fix-view-all-users-focus", so the cleanup laurynmm asked for hasn't happened. The commit messages are unchanged.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and leave the PR unassigned. laurynmm already asked for the cleanup and can re-check after the author rebases.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the update! The history still has a merge commit from `main`. Please rebase onto `main` so only the one focus-styling commit remains, following the [commit discipline guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/commit-discipline.html), then ask for review again.
```
